sourceBreakdowns.title: FHA MMI Fund FY2024 business-operations cash flows by quarter and type
sourceBreakdowns.basis: HUD's FY2024 fourth-quarter report to Congress publishes $19.389B of MMI Fund business-operation collections and $13.868B of signed disbursements, for $5.521B net cash flow. The 36 quarter/type rows reconcile exactly at the source's $1M precision and every leaf is below $10B. HUD calls these figures unaudited and warns that timing and source differences prevent a full reconciliation to other tables; this panel is therefore not an additive child of Treasury's -$27.415B FHA MMI Capital Reserve cash-outlay classification.
